title: Desk Reference — Repeat Billing-Error Share on the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
**Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan — repeat billing errors.** When Bluegate corrects a protection fee charged in billing error, it adds to the correction a repeat-error credit equal to the service-credit base multiplied by the repeat-error share. The share depends on the billing-error corrections the plan already carries on its fee ledger, posted in the 12 whole months before the handling date.

| Billing-error corrections already on the plan, posted in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Repeat-error share |
| --- | --- |
| two or more | 0.5 |
| exactly one | 0.25 |
| none | 0 |

**Reading the ledger.** Count only fee-ledger credits of the kind billing-error correction on this plan. Free-look refund credits are not billing-error corrections and are not counted. A correction posted more than 12 whole months before the handling date is outside the count.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- The plan's fee ledger shows one billing-error correction posted 4 months ago and one posted 15 months ago: one falls in the 12-month look-back, so the share is 0.25.
- It shows two billing-error corrections posted 2 and 9 months ago: the share is 0.5.
- It shows only a free-look refund credit: the share is 0.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A service-credit base of 58.00 multiplied by a repeat-error share of 0.5 gives a repeat-error credit of 29.00.
